title: AI is slowing down
summary: This article presents a contrarian perspective arguing that AI progress is slowing down, challenging the prevailing narrative of rapid AI advancement. Based on Hacker News engagement (576 points, 607 comments), it has sparked significant discussion in the tech community about the true trajectory of AI development.
problem_solved: Questions whether the assumption of continuously accelerating AI progress is accurate, examining empirical evidence of diminishing returns.
why_valuable: Provides a critical counter-narrative that encourages healthy skepticism about AI hype and helps set realistic expectations for AI capabilities and timelines.
